issues.SOCKET_MISMATCH: CPU socket ({{CpuSocket}}) does not match the motherboard socket ({{MbSocket}}).
issues.SOCKET_DATA_MISSING: Cannot verify CPU and motherboard compatibility — insufficient data.
issues.COOLER_TDP_INSUFFICIENT: Cooler {{CoolerName}} ({{CoolerTdp}} W) is below the CPU {{CpuName}} TDP ({{CpuTdp}} W).
issues.COOLER_TDP_DATA_MISSING: Cannot verify cooler and CPU compatibility — insufficient data.
issues.COOLER_SOCKET_MISMATCH: Cooler {{CoolerName}} is not compatible with the motherboard socket ({{MbSocket}}).
issues.COOLER_SOCKET_DATA_MISSING: Cannot verify cooler and motherboard compatibility — insufficient data.
issues.COOLER_CASE_FIT: Cooler {{CoolerName}} does not fit in the case {{CaseName}}.
issues.COOLER_CASE_DATA_MISSING: Cannot verify cooler and case compatibility — insufficient data.
issues.GPU_PCIE_VERSION: Motherboard PCIe slots are an older version than required by the GPU {{GpuName}}. Reduced speed possible.
issues.GPU_PCIE_LANE: Motherboard PCIe slots have lower bandwidth than required by the GPU {{GpuName}}.
issues.GPU_LENGTH_EXCEEDS_CASE: GPU {{GpuName}} length ({{GpuLength}} mm) exceeds the case {{CaseName}} maximum ({{MaxLength}} mm).
issues.GPU_LENGTH_DATA_MISSING: Cannot verify GPU and case compatibility — insufficient data.
issues.RAM_TYPE_MISMATCH: Motherboard does not support RAM type {{RamType}}.
issues.RAM_FREQUENCY_EXCEEDED: RAM {{RamName}} frequency ({{RamFrequency}} MHz) exceeds the motherboard maximum ({{MbMaxFrequency}} MHz).
issues.RAM_SLOTS_EXCEEDED: Motherboard has only {{MbSlots}} DIMM slots, {{ModuleCount}} required.
issues.RAM_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: Total RAM capacity ({{TotalCapacity}} GB) exceeds the maximum ({{MaxCapacity}} GB).
issues.RAM_MIXED_FREQUENCIES: RAM modules have mixed frequencies. Will run at {{MinFrequency}} MHz instead of {{MaxFrequency}} MHz.
issues.SATA_SLOTS_EXCEEDED: Number of SATA drives exceeds available slots ({{FreeSataSlots}}).
issues.M2_SLOTS_MISSING: Cannot check SSD {{SsdName}} — motherboard has no M.2 slots.
issues.M2_SLOTS_EXCEEDED: Number of M.2 SSDs ({{SsdCount}}) exceeds available M.2 slots ({{M2SlotCount}}).
issues.NVME_VERSION_MISMATCH: Motherboard M.2 slots are an older version than the SSD {{SsdName}}. Reduced speed possible.
issues.FAN_HEADERS_INSUFFICIENT: Motherboard has only {{MbHeaders}} fan headers, {{FanCount}} required.
issues.FAN_CASE_SLOTS_INSUFFICIENT: Case {{CaseName}} supports only {{MaxSlots}} fans of size {{FanSize}} mm, {{FanCount}} selected.
issues.FAN_CASE_DATA_MISSING: Cannot verify fan and case compatibility — insufficient data.
issues.PSU_GPU_CONNECTOR_MISSING: PSU {{PsuName}} does not have enough connectors for the GPU{{ConnectorSuffix}}.
issues.PSU_CPU_CONNECTOR_MISSING: PSU {{PsuName}} does not have enough CPU power connectors{{ConnectorSuffix}}.
issues.PSU_INSUFFICIENT: PSU wattage ({{PsuWattage}} W) is insufficient for the system ({{SystemWattage}} W, {{LoadPercentage}}% load).
issues.PSU_OVERKILL: PSU ({{PsuWattage}} W) is significantly overpowered for the system ({{SystemWattage}} W, {{LoadPercentage}}% load).
issues.GPU_BOTTLENECK: GPU {{GpuName}} is overpowered for the CPU {{CpuName}}.
